fusions.name: Heavy Lids
fusions.desc: Fixes a gaze on the first enemy in its line, which deals 11 arcane damage, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and leaves it [Leaden] for 6 seconds, its dodge lowered.

fusions.name: The Slow Blink
fusions.desc: One slow blink across a cone 4 tiles long deals 7 arcane damage to everything in it and leaves it [Stalled] for 6 seconds, so its abilities return slower. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Fixed Regard
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second look, increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Stared Down
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
